description: The AI watches your Billing and Renewals and Hosting Support queues in real time, correlating Genesys Cloud volume with the Marketing send and the Billing batch — so a renewal spike is a briefing before your 9 AM sync, not a surprise at the queue.

Ask what caused the spike and get one sourced answer drawn at once from Genesys Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Billing — the campaign send, the batch timing, the queue volume, and the top contact reasons, together.

The AI compares today's pattern to past renewal cycles and shows where customers get stuck — the price-increase handle-time premium, the save-conversation drop-off — the history the real-time dashboard cannot show you.

The AI forecasts how long the spike sustains and how many contacts turn into cancellations, then models the staffing and deflection actions that hold service level — so you staff the save desk before the wave, not after.

Reroute cross-trained agents, enable the self-service billing explainer and callback, and draft the Marketing notification rule — executed from the conversation, with the Bluehost trade-off surfaced before you commit.
The AI flags the hosting-outage spike as infrastructure, not billing, by correlating contacts with the IT incident timeline — so agents point to a known event instead of troubleshooting individually.
